scripts.//: ElectroBun has no --target flag. `electrobun build --release` always targets the current host platform; per-OS packaging requires running the build on each target OS (or a CI runner for that OS). Artifacts land in dist/.
scripts.package:all: echo 'ElectroBun has no cross-compile flag. Run package:mac on macOS, package:win on Windows, and package:linux on Linux (or wire these to per-OS CI jobs).'
